meaning:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Neh.3.7
§ Melatiah = "Jehovah delivered"
a Gibeonite who assisted in rebuilding the wall of Jerusalem

elsewhere.note: Next to them, Melatiah the Gibeonite, and Jadon the Meronothite, the men of Gibeon and of Mizpah, repaired the residence of the governor beyond the River.
